overview_description.description:
Upstart is a lending platform that leverages artificial intelligence and machine learning to price credit and automates the borrowing process. The company's proprietary underwriting model identifies borrowers despite limited credit and employment history by using variables including schools attended, area of study, and work experience. Upstart powered banks can offer higher approval rates and experience lower loss rates*, while simultaneously delivering the exceptional digital-first lending experience their customers demand.

Upstart was founded in 2012 and headquartered in San Mateo, California and Columbus, Ohio.

about_short_description.short_description: Upstart is a leading AI lending marketplace partnering with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit.

product.name: Upstart AI Lending Platform
product.description: A cloud-based lending platform that helps banks and credit unions automate credit decisioning, verification, fraud detection, and loan origination using artificial intelligence.

product.name: Personal Lending
product.description: A personal loan solution that enables banks and credit unions to originate unsecured consumer loans for uses such as debt consolidation, education, and major expenses.

product.name: Auto Lending
product.description: A digital auto lending solution for vehicle purchases and refinancing that helps lenders originate automotive loans through automated application and decisioning workflows.

product.name: Home Lending
product.description: A home equity line of credit solution that enables lenders to originate HELOCs through a digital application and underwriting experience.

product.name: Upstart Relief Loan
product.description: A small-dollar loan product providing $200 to $2,500 over three to 18 months, with costs disclosed upfront and an APR capped at 36%.

product.name: Borrower Cross-Sell Solution
product.description: A service that helps lending partners develop multi-product customer relationships through targeted marketing, deposit-account onboarding, and account-switching workflows.
